newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASG breaks off cargo contract with Danzas.
newsitem.headline: ASG breaks off cargo contract with Danzas.

text.p: Swedish-based freight forwarding company ASG Air & Sea AB said on Thursday it would break off its global and sea-forwarding alliance with freight forwarder Danzas from June 1.
"The network idea was impossible with Danzas," Roger Olsson, managing director of ASG, told Reuters.
He said Danzas was not able to act as ASG's agent in key markets.
ASG broke off a haulage alliance with Danzas last year.
ASG is re-assessing its ocean and air cargo partners around the world, Olsson said.
He said the company was working to set up a single partner in each of the 30 countries where ASG operates.
A complete list of ASG's new partners would be released in June and was likely to include 40 fewer companies than it had previously, he said.
"It's also very important now when we are going for building up the ASG network around the world," Olsson said.
"We are now doing tracking and tracing on the Internet, which is not possible without a network solution," he said.
